cases.stimulus: Workbench, the PDF preview loads slowly. Investigate and report the findings.
preconditions: A runnable local path may be discoverable.

expected.observable_result: The diagnosis begins from a runnable baseline or reports the exact evidence blocker before causal conclusions.

cases.failure_caught: Workbench previously displaced an independently triggered diagnosis method and allowed theory-building without a baseline.

cases.stimulus: Workbench, start this improvement from a non-repository parent containing a Git child and multiple .workbench stores.
preconditions: The current directory is not a repository.
An intended child repository and competing Workbench stores are discoverable.

expected.observable_result: The first durable intake is written only to the resolved repository's intended store.

cases.failure_caught: Intake was previously captured in a populated non-repository parent store before repository resolution.

cases.stimulus: Should the agent remeasure performance, and should the result stop at findings, a plan, or implementation?
preconditions: Measurement and delivery depth are independently selectable.

expected.observable_result: Choosing a delivery depth neither approves nor rejects measurement.

cases.failure_caught: A single-select previously made complementary actions appear mutually exclusive and turned non-selection into a false refusal.

cases.stimulus: Estimate whether a PDF route will meet a two-second target and state its current AWS cost.
preconditions: No current measurement or retrieved regional pricing is available.

expected.observable_result: No quantitative feasibility or cost conclusion is presented as established without its measurement or authoritative source.

cases.failure_caught: An invented page-render duration previously propagated into latency, timeout, architecture, and cost conclusions.

cases.stimulus: After lifecycle start, the user materially changes latency acceptance and persistent identity requirements.
preconditions: The bound routing receipt contains the superseded criteria.
The installed runtime has no supported post-start correction mutation.

expected.observable_result: Affected work remains blocked until a supported correction preserves the new contract and prior lineage.

cases.failure_caught: A scratch artifact previously claimed to supersede immutable routing and five phases advanced on stale acceptance evidence.

cases.stimulus: Record implementation authorization derived from the initiating user request.
preconditions: The exact captured request is available.
The authorization is recorded later than the user's message.

expected.observable_result: The authorization is checkable against the exact user source and does not pretend the recording operation was the granting event.

cases.failure_caught: A retry timestamp and agent paraphrase previously became the durable human grant provenance.
